relied on this research and ranking broker’s recommendations and invested in three stocks based on their advice. Read news and do your own research to invest in stocks.

featured_reviews.name: Sridhar Reddy Ratna
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear fellows, Don't get trapped with positive reviews. Here is the detailed explanation why you shouldn't trust.

Who ever given positive reviews, none provided details about why positive what gains and any evidence for positive reviews.

Whereas for negative reviews, everyone provided well defined, articulated and evidence driven proof.

Look at the company response for those negative reviews. They asking to call customer support... Funny.. after reaching out there only.. given negative reviews...

I will explain my experience. I called these guys to get details. They are saying mesmerizing stories and showing dreams of profits. But when asked about there recommendations for recent, they absolutely don't have any clear knowledge on how a stock picked up.
At the end, what I found is, they follow some twitter handle who provide stock recommendations,  they simply copy some of them.
So don't be victim... Your greed for profit in short term without investment knowledge is weapon to these firms for milking your hard earned money

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Varma
featured_reviews.review_text:
"Rude & Unprofessional Sales Team — Beware"

I registered on the Equentis platform to explore their advisory services. When I politely declined and said I'm currently not looking for this, their sales representative responded with "Why did you register?" and "Yesterday you were talking very big." This is how they speak to a potential customer who simply said no.
When I pointed out this behavior, they deflected by sharing their Google rating instead of apologizing. No accountability, no professionalism.
I have screenshots of the entire conversation. If this is how they treat prospects, I shudder to think how they treat paying customers — which aligns with the many negative reviews about zero post-payment support.
Do your research before subscribing. Check SEBI SCORES for complaints against them.

featured_reviews.name: Asif Pasha
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with this organisation has been very disappointing.
Initially, when I took the service, the advisor clearly said I could choose any sector for investment. However, after making the payment, I was given a fixed portfolio, which was completely different from what was promised.

After one year, another advisor contacted me saying they would “fix the problem.” I honestly shared that I had trust issues with the organisation due to being misled previously. In response, the employee sent a rude and unprofessional message saying, “if you are not interested, don’t waste time on a call with any employee”.

I want to clearly state that I did not call them or ask for any new subscription—they contacted me. Instead of addressing the concern professionally, the response showed a lack of respect and accountability.

Based on misleading commitments and unprofessional communication, I would not recommend this service to others. Transparency and customer handling need great improvement.
